title: Reading Decoder Trajectories: Training-Free Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability for Small-Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.06581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small-object detection remains challenging because limited pixels cause information loss and suppress the scale knowledge encoded in pretrained detectors. Existing approaches mainly improve representations through multiscale training, architecture redesign, or parameter adaptation, implicitly assuming that frozen models lack the required capability. We challenge this assumption and hypothesize that small-object knowledge already exists in frozen detectors but remains underactivated and unstable during query evolution. To test this hypothesis, we propose Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability (CQTR), a training-free framework that elicits latent responses through counterfactual scale interventions and interprets candidate reliability from decoder-internal spatial convergence, semantic persistence, and cross-scale conflicts. translated_title: 读取解码器轨迹：面向小目标检测的免训练反事实查询-轨迹可靠性
translated_abstract: 小目标检测仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为有限的像素会导致信息丢失，并抑制预训练检测器中已编码的尺度知识。现有方法主要通过多尺度训练、架构重新设计或参数适配来改进特征表示，隐含地假设冻结模型缺乏所需的能力。我们挑战了这一假设，并提出假设：小目标知识已经存在于冻结检测器中，只是在查询演化过程中处于未充分激活且不稳定的状态。为了验证这一假设，我们提出了反事实查询-轨迹可靠性，这是一个免训练框架，通过反事实尺度干预引出潜在响应，并从解码器内部的空间收敛性、语义持续性和跨尺度冲突来解读候选目标的可靠性。一个小的无标注训练子集用于为每个模型-数据流选择合适的校正机制……
tldr: 提出免训练的反事实查询-轨迹可靠性框架CQTR，通过反事实尺度干预并解读解码器内部轨迹（空间收敛、语义持续性与跨尺度冲突），激活并稳定冻结检测器中已存在但未充分激活的小目标检测知识。
en_tdlr: Proposes CQTR, a training-free framework that elicits latent small-object knowledge in frozen detectors via counterfactual scale interventions and interprets candidate reliability from decoder-internal trajectories, including spatial convergence, semantic persistence, and cross-scale conflicts.
